37600.meaning1: leading to putting out the fire; conducive to Nibbāna

examples.text: nekkhammavitakko, bhikkhave, anandhakaraṇo cakkhukaraṇo ñāṇakaraṇo paññāvuddhiko avighātapakkhiko nibbānasaṃvattaniko.
so ca kho n'ev'attabyābādhāya saṃvattati, na parabyābādhāya saṃvattati, na ubhayabyābādhāya saṃvattati, paññāvuddhiko avighātapakkhiko nibbānasaṃvattaniko.

37601.meaning1: ease of Nibbāna; relief of quenching
37601.commentary: (THIa) nibbānasukhā paraṃ n'atthī'ti nibbānasukhato paraṃ aññaṃ uttamaṃ sukhaṃ nāma n'atthi lokiyasukhassa vipariṇāma-saṅkhāradukkha-sabhāvattā. ten'āha bhagavā, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukhan'ti (dha. pa. 203-204).

examples.text: ghātā nirayesu bahū, vinipātagatassa pīḷiyamānassa, devesu'pi attāṇaṃ, nibbānasukhā paraṃ n'atthi.

37607.meaning1: is very close to Nibbāna; very near to extinguishing

examples.text: appamādarato bhikkhu, pamāde bhayadassi vā, abhabbo parihānāya, nibbānass'eva santike.
yassa etādisaṃ yānaṃ, itthiyā purisassa vā, sa ve etena yānena, nibbānass'eva santike'ti.

37609.meaning1: intent on Nibbāna; resolved on extinguishing

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, tālo matthakacchinno abhabbo puna viruḷhiyā. evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, sammā nibbān'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye n'evasaññā-n'āsaññ'āyatana-saṃyojane se ucchinnamūle tāl'āvatthukate anabhāvaṃkate āyatiṃ anuppādadhamme.

37610.meaning1: taking delight in extinguishing; indulging in going out
37610.meaning2: finding delight in nibbāna, fond of nibbāna

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, bhikkhu nibbān'ābhirato pajahāsi sakkāyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā'ti.
saddhā dutiyā purisassa hoti, paññā c'enaṃ pasāsati, nibbān'ābhirato macco, sabbadukkhā pamuccatī'ti.
accayāsi, brāhmaṇa, pañhaṃ, n'āsakkhi pañhassa pariyantaṃ gahetuṃ. nibbān'ogadhañ'hi, brāhmaṇa, brahmacariyaṃ vussati nibbānaparāyaṇaṃ nibbānapariyosānan'ti.

37614.commentary: (ANa) nibbān'ogadhagāminan'ti nibbānassa antogāminaṃ. maggabrahmacariyañ'hi nibbānaṃ ārammaṇaṃ karitvā nibbānassa anto'y'eva vattati pavattati.

examples.text: saṃvar'atthaṃ pahān'atthaṃ, brahmacariyaṃ anītihaṃ, adesayi so bhagavā, nibbān'ogadhagāminaṃ, esa maggo mahantehi, anuyāto mah'esibhi.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ādittacelo vā ādittasīso vā, tass'eva celassa vā sīsassa vā nibbāpanāya adhimattaṃ chandañ'ca vāyāmañ'ca ussāhañ'ca ussoḷhiñ'ca appaṭivāniñ'ca satiñ'ca sampajaññañ'ca kareyya.
kāmarāgena ḍayhāmi, cittaṃ me pariḍayhati, sādhu nibbāpanaṃ brūhi, anukampāya gotamā'ti.
tālavaṇṭaṃ mayā dinnaṃ, tissass'ādiccabandhuno, gimhanibbāpan'atthāya, pariḷāh'opasantiyā.

37618.meaning1: causes to grow cold; makes cool down

examples.text: sace, bhikkhave, suvaṇṇakāro vā suvaṇṇakār'antevāsī vā taṃ jātarūpaṃ ek'antaṃ udakena paripphoseyya, ṭhānaṃ taṃ jātarūpaṃ nibbāpeyya

yathā, mahārāja, atipavaratāya dibbaṃ vanamūlaṃ gahitam'pi hatthapāse ṭhitānaṃ parajanānaṃ na dassayati, agado atijaccatāya pīḷāya samugghātako rogānaṃ antakaro, aggi atijotitāya ḍahati, udakaṃ atisītatāya nibbāpeti, padumaṃ parisuddhatāya na upalimpati vārikaddamena

37620.meaning1: (of a fire) wanting to put out; wanting to extinguish

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetu'kāmo assa. so tattha sukkhāni c'eva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya, sukkhāni ca gomayāni pakkhipeyya

37621.meaning1: (of fire) to extinguish; to put out

examples.text: bhabbo nu kho so puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetun'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante

37622.meaning1: (of fire) having extinguished; having put out; having caused to cool
37622.meaning2: having put out, having cooled, having extinguished

examples.text: daḍḍhe ca kho pana bhagavato sarīre antalikkhā udakadhārā pātubhavitvā bhagavato citakaṃ nibbāpesi.

37625.meaning1: (of fire) is extinguished (from); goes out (because of)

examples.text: sā harit'antaṃ vā panth'antaṃ vā sel'antaṃ vā udak'antaṃ vā ramaṇīyaṃ vā bhūmibhāgaṃ āgamma anāhārā nibbāyati. hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ kukkuṭapattena'pi nhārudaddulena'pi aggiṃ gavesanti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, telañ'ca paṭicca vaṭṭiñ'ca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya, tass'eva telassa ca vaṭṭiyā ca pariyādānā anāhāro nibbāyeyya

37626.meaning2: getting cold, becoming passionless, being extinguished

examples.text: atha kho tesaṃ, vāseṭṭha, sattānaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena rasapathavī udakasmiṃ samatani, seyyathā'pi nāma payaso tattassa nibbāyamānassa upari santānakaṃ hoti, evam'eva pāturahosi.

37628.meaning1: (of an arahant) died one's last death; attained final emancipation
37628.meaning2: got cold, became passionless, was extinguished

examples.text: yadatthikaṃ brahmacariyaṃ acarī, kappāyano kacci'ssa taṃ amoghaṃ, nibbāyi so ādu saupādiseso, yathā vimutto ahu taṃ suṇoma.
icchām'ahaṃ, tāta, janapadaṃ gantuṃ, aggiṃ, tāta, paricareyyāsi. mā ca te aggi nibbāyi.

37631.meaning2: having got cold, having become passionless, having been extinguished

examples.text: n'āhaṃ taṃ, bhante nāgasena, vihesāpekkho pucchāmi, api ca nibbāhan'atthāya sandehassa pucchāmi, bahū manussā loke vāmagāmino vicakkhukā, kin'ti te otāraṃ na labheyyun'ti ev'āhaṃ taṃ pucchāmī'ti.

37635.grammar: abs of caus of nī √vah, caus, trans (+acc)
37635.meaning1: having transported away; having carried away

examples.text: sace me tvaṃ, gahapati, vacanaṃ kareyyāsi, imaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇassa puñjaṃ sakaṭe āropetvā nibbāhāpetvā majjhegaṅgāya nadiyā sote opilāpeyyāsi.
tena hi tvaṃ mahante mahante sāṇipasibbake kārāpetvā hiraññasuvaṇṇassa pūrāpetvā sakaṭehi nibbāhāpetvā majjhe gaṅgāya sote osādehi.

37637.grammar: ptp of caus of nī √vah, caus (+instr)
37637.meaning1: should be solved; should be unpacked; should be unravelled; should be explained (by)
37637.meaningLit: to cause to be carried out

examples.text: ayam'pi ubhato koṭiko pañho tav'ānuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo'ti.

37638.meaning2: having torn out; having plucked out

examples.text: so lābhasakkāraṃ jigucchanto pabbajjaṃ anupagantvā, pahomi c'āhaṃ lābh'ālābh'ādīsu nibbikāro hotun'ti attānaṃ takkento, visesato para-paribhava-sahan'ādi-paṭipadaṃ pūrento upekkhāpāramiṃ matthakaṃ pāpessāmī'ti

37641.construction:
nir + vi + cikiccha + ā + a
nibbicikicchā + a

examples.text: yesañ'ca kho etaṃ bhante ñātaṃ diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ phassitaṃ paññāya, nikkaṅkhā te nibbicikicchā

37642.grammar: fem, abstr, from vicikicchā, neg, desid

examples.text: bhūtam'idan'ti, bhikkhave, iti'pi vo ettha nibbicikicchā'ti? evaṃ, bhante. tadāhārasambhavan'ti, bhikkhave, iti'pi vo ettha nibbicikicchā'ti? evaṃ, bhante.
saddahatha me taṃ, bhikkhave, adhimuccatha, nikkaṅkhā ettha hotha nibbicikicchā. es'ev'anto dukkhassā'ti.

37643.meaning1: losing interest (in); becoming disenchanted (with); becoming disillusioned (with); being fed up (with)

examples.text: yadā kho, bhikkhave, kummo kacchapo soṇḍipañcamānaṃ aṅgānaṃ aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgaṃ na abhininnāmi, atha siṅgālo kummamhā nibbijja pakkāmi, otāraṃ alabhamāno.
so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, taṃ dhammaṃ analaṅ'karitvā tasmā dhammā nibbijja apakkamiṃ.

37645.commentary: (MNa) nibbijja pakkamatī'ti attano'pi esa satthā avassayo bhavituṃ na sakkoti, mayhaṃ kiṃ sakkhissatī'ti nibbinditvā pakkamati.

examples.text: abhisamparāyaṃ so'haṃ kiṃ jānanto kiṃ passanto imasmiṃ satthari brahmacariyaṃ carissāmi? so abrahmacariyavāso ayan'ti, iti viditvā tasmā brahmacariyā nibbijj'āpakkamati.

37646.meaning1: leaves having lost interest; departs disheartened; goes away fed up
37646.commentary: (SNa) nibbijj'āpema gotamaṃ āsajja tato gotamā nibbijja apemā'ti.

examples.text: selaṃ'va siras'ūhacca, pātāle gādham'esatha, khāṇuṃ'va uras'āsajja, nibbijj'āpetha gotamā'ti.
aladdhā tattha assādaṃ, vāyas'etto apakkami, kāko'va selamāsajja, nibbijj'āpema gotamaṃ.
yass'indriyāni bhāvitāni, ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca sabbaloke, nibbijjha imaṃ parañ'ca lokaṃ, kālaṃ kaṅkhati bhāvito sa danto.
yāni loke gadhitāni, na tesu pasuto siyā, nibbijjha sabbaso kāme, sikkhe nibbānam'attano.

so satisambojjh'aṅgaṃ bhāvitena cittena anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ lobhakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti, anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ dosakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti, anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ mohakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti

37655.meaning1: having penetrated; having pierced through; having broken through (something with)

examples.text: kāyena c'eva paramasaccan'ti sahajātanāmakāyena ca nibbānaṃ sacchikaroti, paññāya ca kilese nibbijjhitvā tadeva vibhūtaṃ pākaṭaṃ karonto passati.

37657.meaning2: whose service to the king had been recompensed or paid off(?)

37658.meaning1: for the purpose of dis-enchantment; for the sake of disinterest

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, virāgo vimuttiñāṇadassan'attho vimuttiñāṇadassan'ānisaṃso, nibbidā virāg'atthā virāg'ānisaṃsā, yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ nibbid'atthaṃ nibbid'ānisaṃsaṃ

37659.meaning1: perception of disenchantment; recognition of disillusionment (in)

examples.text: sabbasaṅkhāresu ca me nibbidasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā bhavissati, seyyathā'pi ukkhitt'āsike vadhake. sabbalokā ca me mano vuṭṭhahissati, nibbāne ca santadassāvī bhavissāmi

37660.notes: There is no 1:1 English equivalent. The sense that is trying to be conveyed here is state of enchantment ending, hence dis-enchantment.

examples.text: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya atītasmiṃ rūpasmiṃ anapekkho hoti, anāgataṃ rūpaṃ n'ābhinandati, paccuppannassa rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti
evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako… viññāṇasmiṃ nibbindati, nibbidā virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam'iti ñāṇaṃ hoti.

37661.meaning1: for the benefit of dis-enchantment; for the advantage of disinterest

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, virāgo vimuttiñāṇadassan'attho vimuttiñāṇadassan'ānisaṃso, nibbidā virāg'atthā virāg'ānisaṃsā, yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ nibbid'atthaṃ nibbid'ānisaṃsaṃ

37663.meaning1: fact of seeing (something) as dis-enchanting; fact of observing with disinterest

examples.text: katame dve? yā ca saṃyojaniyesu dhammesu assād'ānupassitā, yā ca saṃyojaniyesu dhammesu nibbid'ānupassitā. saṃyojaniyesu, bhikkhave, dhammesu assād'ānupassī viharanto rāgaṃ na pajahati, dosaṃ na pajahati, mohaṃ na pajahati.

37664.meaning1: seeing (something) as dis-enchanting; observing with disinterest

examples.text: saṃyojaniyesu, bhikkhave, dhammesu nibbid'ānupassī viharanto rāgaṃ pajahati, dosaṃ pajahati, mohaṃ pajahati. rāgaṃ pahāya, dosaṃ pahāya, mohaṃ pahāya, parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi.

37665.meaning1: full of dis-enchantment; filled with disinterest (towards)
37665.commentary: (SNa) nibbidābahulo'ti ukkaṇṭhanabahulo hutvā. (THa) nibbidābahulo bhavā'ti attabhāve sabbasmiñ'ca nibbedabahulo hohi.

examples.text: asubhāya cittaṃ bhāvehi, ek'aggaṃ susamāhitaṃ, sati kāyagatā ty'atthu, nibbidābahulo bhava.

dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipannassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ayam'anudhammo hoti yaṃ rūpe nibbidābahulo vihareyya, vedanāya nibbidābahulo vihareyya, saññā nibbidābahulo vihareyya, saṅkhāresu nibbidābahulo vihareyya, viññāṇe nibbidābahulo vihareyya.

37670.meaning1: dis-enchantment and detachment; disinterest and dispassion

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, nibbidāvirāgo vimuttiñāṇadassan'attho vimuttiñāṇadassan'ānisaṃso, yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ nibbidāvirāg'atthaṃ nibbidāvirāg'ānisaṃsaṃ

37671.meaning1: for the purpose of dis-enchantment and detachment; for the sake of disinterest and dispassion

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, nibbidāvirāgo vimuttiñāṇadassan'attho vimuttiñāṇadassan'ānisaṃso, yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ nibbidāvirāg'atthaṃ nibbidāvirāg'ānisaṃsaṃ

37672.meaning1: who has successfully achieved dis-enchantment and detachment; with disinterest and dispassion

examples.text: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūta-ñāṇadassana-sampannassa upanisasampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo, nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.

37673.meaning1: who has failed in dis-enchantment and detachment; without disinterest and dispassion

examples.text: dussīlassa, bhikkhave, sīlavipannassa hat'ūpaniso hoti sammāsamādhi, sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hat'ūpanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūta-ñāṇadassana-vipannassa hat'ūpaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo, nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hat'ūpanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.

37674.meaning1: for the benefit of dis-enchantment and detachment; for the advantage of disinterest and dispassion

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, nibbidāvirāgo vimuttiñāṇadassan'attho vimuttiñāṇadassan'ānisaṃso, yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ nibbidāvirāg'atthaṃ nibbidāvirāg'ānisaṃsaṃ

iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.

37678.meaning2: being dissatisfied or disgusted; weary; turning away

examples.text: ye'pi nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā te'pi nigaṇṭhesu nāṭaputtiyesu nibbindarūpā virattarūpā paṭivānarūpā yathā taṃ durakkhāte dhammavinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasamasaṃvattanike asammāsambuddhappavedite bhinnathūpe appaṭisaraṇe.

37679.meaning1: is disenchanted (with); is disinterested (in); is disillusioned (by); loses interest (in); is dispassionate (towards)
37679.meaning2: gets wearied of, is disgusted with

examples.text: yaṃ kiñci pasavati, asuci'y'eva pasavati, duggandhaṃ'y'eva pasavati, jegucchiyaṃ'y'eva pasavati. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, imasmiṃ kāye nibbindathā'ti.
sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā'ti, yadā paññāya passati, atha nibbindati dukkhe, esa maggo visuddhiyā.
karoto cīyati pāpaṃ, cirarattāya antaka, māra nibbinda buddhamhā, āsaṃ m'ākāsi bhikkhusu.

37681.meaning1: being disenchanted (by); becoming disinterested (in); being disillusioned (by); losing interest (in)

37682.meaning1: being disenchanted (by); being disinterested (in); being disillusioned (by); losing interest (in)

examples.text: nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam'iti ñāṇaṃ hoti
evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako… viññāṇasmiṃ nibbindati, nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam'iti ñāṇaṃ hoti.

37683.meaning1: being disenchanted (by); becoming disinterested (in); being disillusioned (by); losing interest (in)
37683.commentary: (ANa) sammā nibbindamāno'ti-ādīsu pana sammā hetunā nayena nibbid'ānupassanāya nibbindanto ukkaṇṭhanto, virāg'ānupassanāya virajjanto, paṭisaṅkh'ānupassanāya muccanassa upāyaṃ katvā vimuccamāno, adhimokkhavasena vā vimuccamāno sanniṭṭhānaṃ kurumāno'ti attho.

examples.text: sabbe sattā āhāraṭṭhitikā, imasmiṃ kho, bhikkhave, ekadhamme bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī samma'd'atthaṃ abhisamecca diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti.

ye'pi nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā te'pi nigaṇṭhesu nāṭaputtiyesu nibbindarūpā virattarūpā paṭivānarūpā yathā taṃ durakkhāte dhammavinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasamasaṃvattanike asammāsambuddhappavedite bhinnathūpe appaṭisaraṇe.

37685.meaning1: became dis-enchanted (with); was disinterested (in); was disillusioned (by); lost interest (in); was dispassionate (towards)
37685.meaning2: got wearied of, was disgusted with
37685.commentary: (THIa) atha nibbind'ahaṃ rūpe'ti evaṃ rūp'ūpajīvinī hutvā ṭhitā. atha pacchā sāsanaṃ nissāya rūpe ahaṃ nibbindiṃ iti'pi rūpaṃ aniccaṃ, iti'p'idaṃ rūpaṃ dukkhaṃ, asubhan'ti passantī tattha ukkaṇṭhiṃ.

examples.text: atha nibbind'ahaṃ rūpe, nibbindañ'ca virajj'ahaṃ, mā puna jātisaṃsāraṃ, sandhāveyyaṃ punappunaṃ, tisso vijjā sacchikatā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan'ti.

37686.meaning1: to become dis-enchanted (with); to become disinterested (in); to be disillusioned (with); to lose interest (in)

examples.text: yāvañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, alam'eva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ alaṃ virajjituṃ alaṃ vimuccitun'ti.
yañ'ca kho etaṃ, bhikkhave, vuccati cittaṃ iti'pi, mano iti'pi, viññāṇaṃ iti'pi, tatr'āssutavā puthujjano n'ālaṃ nibbindituṃ n'ālaṃ virajjituṃ n'ālaṃ vimuccituṃ.

37687.meaning2: having got wearied of, having been disgusted with

37688.meaning1: who is dis-enchanted; who is disinterested; who is disillusioned; who has lost interest; who is dispassionate
37688.meaning2: got wearied of, was disgusted with, was disheartened or disgusted

examples.text: nibbinnassa, bhikkhave, virattassa na cetanāya karaṇīyaṃ, vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ sacchikaromī'ti. dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yaṃ nibbinno viratto vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ sacchikaroti.

ye'pi nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā te'pi nigaṇṭhesu nāṭaputtiyesu nibbinnarūpā virattarūpā paṭivānarūpā yathā taṃ durakkhāte dhammavinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasamasaṃvattanike asammāsambuddhappavedite bhinnathūpe appaṭisaraṇe.
n'ābhinandāmi maraṇaṃ, n'ābhinandāmi jīvitaṃ, kālañ'ca paṭikaṅkhāmi, nibbisaṃ bhatako yathā.

37697.meaning1: without energy; with no power; impotent

examples.text: ādhāvanti'pi, usseḷenti'pi, apphoṭenti'pi, nibbujjhanti'pi, muṭṭhīhi'pi yujjhanti, raṅgamajjhe'pi saṅghāṭiṃ pattharitvā naccakiṃ evaṃ vadanti, idha, bhagini, naccassū'ti, nalāṭikam'pi denti, vividham'pi anācāraṃ ācaranti.

37699.meaning2: got cold, become passionless, was extinguished

examples.text: mahāginī'va jalito, anāhār'ūpasammati, saṅkhāres'ūpasantesu, nibbuto'ti pavuccati.
kāmesu brahmacariyavā, vītataṇho sadā sato, saṅkhāya nibbuto bhikkhu, tassa no santi iñjitā.
